datapoints.label: Policy and validity
datapoints.value: Maharashtra GCC Policy 2025 (GR dated 3 Nov 2025), valid to FY2029–30

datapoints.label: Payroll subsidy (Zone 1)
datapoints.value: 40% of salary above Rs 1 lakh a month, up to Rs 50,000 per employee for 3 years; capped at 100 employees per GCC a year and Rs 5 crore per company a year

datapoints.label: Capital subsidy
datapoints.value: 20% of eligible investment, capped at Rs 10 crore (small) to Rs 100 crore (very large)

datapoints.label: Rent subsidy (Zone 1)
datapoints.value: 10% for 5 years, capped at Rs 1–4 crore by tier

incentives.gapNote: Stamp-duty concession percentages are not specified in the GR; it refers to the MAITS 2023 policy.
incentives.validationNeeded: Stamp-duty terms under MAITS 2023 and the scheme's operating guidelines for claiming each subsidy.
